item.title: AWS Lambda announces Lambda Web Functions
item.description: AWS Lambda announces Lambda Web Functions, a new serverless compute primitive where your code handles HTTP requests directly. Your code listens on a port and handles requests as it would on any HTTP server. (4 sources: aws, javascriptweekly, nodeweekly, rprogramming)

item.title: Zod Brings In-Process Schema Compilation and a 9x Cut in Memory Footprint
item.description: Zod is a TypeScript-focused schema validation library that recently released versions 4.5 and 4.6. Key updates include schema compilation for faster data parsing, significant memory usage reductions, and new validation features. (1 source: infoq)
